title: A Newborn Cuckoo Shoves Every Other Egg Out of the Nest

scenes.text: A naked baby bird shoves every other egg out of the nest.
The common cuckoo never builds a nest. It lays an egg in a smaller bird's nest and leaves.
Then the chick pushes the host's eggs out, balancing them on its back and heaving them over the edge.
Now it gets all the food. At fourteen days old, it's about three times the size of an adult reed warbler.
And its begging call sounds like a whole brood of hungry chicks, so the foster parents keep feeding.

subject: common cuckoo
description:
A naked baby bird shoves every other egg out of the nest.
The common cuckoo lays one egg in another bird's nest, hatches first, and evicts the competition.
Have you ever heard a cuckoo call?
first_comment: Is this nature's cleverest cheat? What animal should we cover next?
